title: Trump and Xi Meet in Washington for High-Stakes Talks
subtitle: The two leaders seek to manage global tensions and improve cooperation on technology and trade.

summary.en: President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping have held a significant summit at the White House. The two leaders discussed ways to manage competition in areas like artificial intelligence and trade. President Xi called for better communication to avoid future military conflict. Both sides expressed a desire to build a more stable relationship despite existing tensions. The visit marks a major moment in international diplomacy as the United States celebrates its 250th anniversary.
summary.zh: 美國總統川普與中國領導人習近平在白宮舉行了一場重要的峰會。兩位領導人討論了管控人工智慧與貿易等領域競爭的方法。習近平呼籲加強溝通以避免未來的軍事衝突。儘管存在緊張局勢，雙方皆表達了建立更穩定關係的意願。在美國慶祝建國兩百五十週年之際，此次訪問標誌著國際外交的一個重要時刻。

paragraphs.en: President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping have met at the White House for a significant state visit. This meeting comes at a time when both nations are dealing with domestic political pressures and trying to stabilize their complex relationship. The two leaders are working to manage rising tensions regarding trade, artificial intelligence, and military competition.
paragraphs.zh: 美國總統川普（Donald Trump）與中國領導人習近平在白宮舉行了一場重要的國是訪問。此次會晤正值兩國皆面臨國內政治壓力，並試圖穩定雙方複雜關係之際。兩位領導人正致力於管控在貿易、人工智慧及軍事競爭方面日益升高的緊張局勢。

paragraphs.en: At the start of the summit, President Xi called for extensive cooperation between Washington and Beijing. According to The Guardian, Xi warned about the "Thucydides trap," a term used to describe the risk of war when a rising power challenges an established one. To avoid this, Xi proposed that the two countries focus on mutual gain rather than confrontation. He suggested that China and the United States should strengthen communication and build trust through regular, in-depth dialogue.
paragraphs.zh: 峰會伊始，習近平呼籲華盛頓與北京之間進行廣泛合作。根據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，習近平警告了「修昔底德陷阱」（Thucydides trap），這是一個用來描述當新興強權挑戰既有強權時，可能引發戰爭風險的術語。為了避免這種情況，習近平提議兩國應聚焦於互利而非對抗。他建議中美兩國應加強溝通，並透過定期且深入的對話建立互信。

paragraphs.en: President Xi also proposed a plan to increase cultural ties, including an invitation for 100,000 young Americans to visit China for student exchange programs. He emphasized that the two militaries should maintain regular contact to improve crisis communication and prevent accidents. "China and the United States, as two major countries, stand to gain from cooperation and will both lose in confrontation," Xi stated during the meeting.
paragraphs.zh: 習近平亦提出了一項增進文化連結的計畫，包括邀請十萬名美國青年赴中進行學生交流。他強調兩軍應保持定期聯繫，以改善危機溝通並防止意外發生。習近平在會中表示：「中美作為兩個大國，合作則兩利，對抗則兩傷。」

paragraphs.en: For his part, President Trump welcomed the Chinese leader and his wife, Peng Liyuan, to the White House. Trump noted that this is a special time for the United States, as the country is currently celebrating its 250th anniversary. The President highlighted the personal relationship he has built with Xi, describing it as a "truly great friendship." He also mentioned that their teams have been working hard to create a more balanced trading relationship, which includes providing new market access for American farmers and ranchers.
paragraphs.zh: 川普則歡迎這位中國領導人及其夫人彭麗媛造訪白宮。川普指出，這對美國而言是一個特殊的時刻，因為該國目前正慶祝建國兩百五十週年。總統強調了他與習近平建立的個人關係，並將其形容為「一段真正偉大的友誼」。他也提到，雙方團隊一直努力創造更平衡的貿易關係，其中包括為美國農民與牧場主提供新的市場准入機會。

paragraphs.en: Technology was a major part of the discussion. President Trump referred to artificial intelligence as "super intelligence," a term he recently introduced at the United Nations. Both leaders are looking for ways to manage the rapid development of this technology, which has become a central point of competition between the two superpowers. NPR reports that despite the long list of difficult topics, the meeting was relatively short, reflecting the challenge of balancing such a wide range of complex issues.
paragraphs.zh: 科技是討論的主要議題之一。川普將人工智慧稱為「超級智慧」，這是他近期在聯合國提出的一個術語。兩位領導人皆在尋求管控這項技術快速發展的方法，因為這已成為兩大超級強權之間競爭的核心焦點。美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR）報導稱，儘管議題清單冗長且艱難，但此次會晤相對短暫，反映出要在如此廣泛且複雜的問題之間取得平衡是一項挑戰。

paragraphs.en: This summit follows a series of earlier discussions between the two leaders, including a visit by President Trump to China earlier this year. During that trip, both sides agreed to work toward "strategic stability," a state where both countries feel secure and avoid sudden, dangerous actions. President Xi expressed his readiness to continue this work, saying he wants to steer the "giant ship" of the China-US relationship on a steady course toward the future.
paragraphs.zh: 此次峰會延續了兩位領導人先前的一系列討論，包括川普今年稍早對中國的訪問。在那次行程中，雙方同意致力於「戰略穩定」，即兩國皆感到安全並避免採取突發且危險行動的狀態。習近平表達了持續推動此工作的意願，表示他希望引領中美關係這艘「巨輪」穩步駛向未來。

paragraphs.en: While both leaders spoke positively about their personal rapport, the reality of the relationship remains difficult. The two countries have been imposing tariffs—taxes on imported goods—on each other, which has created economic stress. The summit serves as a test of whether personal diplomacy can overcome deep-seated disagreements on security, technology, and global influence.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管兩位領導人對彼此的個人交情給予正面評價，但雙邊關係的現實依然嚴峻。兩國一直對彼此的進口商品加徵關稅，這已造成經濟壓力。此次峰會是一場考驗，測試個人外交能否克服雙方在安全、科技及全球影響力方面根深蒂固的分歧。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the success of this summit will likely be measured by whether the two nations can actually implement the mechanisms for communication that Xi proposed. As the world watches, the ability of Washington and Beijing to manage their competition will have a major impact on global stability. For now, both sides seem committed to keeping the lines of communication open, hoping that continued dialogue will prevent the competition from turning into a more dangerous conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，此次峰會的成功與否，很可能取決於兩國能否真正落實習近平所提議的溝通機制。在全世界的注視下，華盛頓與北京管控競爭的能力，將對全球穩定產生重大影響。目前看來，雙方似乎都致力於保持溝通管道暢通，期盼持續的對話能防止競爭演變成更危險的衝突。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be in a position where you are likely to receive a benefit or advantage.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 很有可能獲得利益、處於有利地位。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語並非指「站著去贏」，而是指「處於獲利的位置」。文中：China and the United States, as two major countries, stand to gain from cooperation and will both lose in confrontation

keyTerms.definitionEn: To guide or control the movement or direction of something.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作駕駛交通工具（如開車），這裡比喻引導兩國關係的發展方向。文中：President Xi expressed his readiness to continue this work, saying he wants to steer the "giant ship" of the China-US relationship on a steady course toward the future.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A situation that shows how good or effective something is.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作考試，這裡指對某事物的成效進行檢驗。文中：The summit serves as a test of whether personal diplomacy can overcome deep-seated disagreements on security, technology, and global influence.

quiz.question: What specific initiative did President Xi propose to foster better cultural relations between the two nations?

options.A: Increasing the number of military diplomats stationed in each capital.
options.B: Inviting 100,000 young Americans to participate in student exchange programs.
options.C: Establishing a new trade committee for American farmers and ranchers.
options.D: Hosting a joint celebration for the 250th anniversary of the United States.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，習近平主席提議增加文化聯繫，具體計畫是邀請 10 萬名美國青年到中國參加學生交流計畫。選項 A 錯誤，因為軍事聯繫是為了改善危機溝通，而非文化交流；選項 C 是川普提出的貿易相關提議；選項 D 雖然文章提到美國正在慶祝 250 週年，但這並非習近平提出的文化交流計畫。

quiz.question: Based on the article, what can be inferred about the current state of the US-China relationship?

options.A: The two nations have successfully resolved their trade disputes through recent tariffs.
options.B: The leaders believe that personal friendship is enough to eliminate all geopolitical competition.
options.C: Despite public displays of rapport, the underlying relationship remains strained by systemic disagreements.
options.D: The two leaders have decided to halt all technological competition to focus on global stability.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第七段提到，儘管兩位領導人對個人關係評價正面，但現實狀況依然困難，且關稅造成的經濟壓力持續存在。選項 A 錯誤，因為關稅實際上造成了壓力；選項 B 錯誤，文章並未暗示個人友誼能解決所有問題，僅提到這是個測試；選項 D 錯誤，科技競爭仍是兩國討論的核心議題，並未停止。

quiz.question: In the sixth paragraph, what does the phrase 'steer the giant ship' imply in the context of the China-US relationship?

options.A: To guide and manage the complex and massive relationship between the two countries.
options.B: To literally transport goods between China and the United States by sea.
options.C: To build a new naval fleet to strengthen military cooperation.
options.D: To speed up the process of reaching a final political agreement.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。這裡的「giant ship」是一個隱喻，用來形容中美關係這種龐大且複雜的雙邊互動。習近平說要 steer（駕駛/引導）這艘船，意指在未來保持關係穩定。選項 B 是字面錯誤解讀；選項 C 與軍事艦隊無關；選項 D 雖然提到穩定，但「steer」強調的是過程中的控制與方向，而非單純的加速達成協議。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding the summit between President Trump and President Xi?

options.A: The summit was a failure because the two leaders could not agree on artificial intelligence.
options.B: The meeting focused exclusively on the 250th anniversary of the United States.
options.C: The leaders are attempting to balance intense competition with the need for stable communication.
options.D: The two nations have agreed to end their trade war entirely to prioritize cultural exchange.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章整體論述了中美兩國在面對貿易、科技與軍事競爭的同時，雙方領導人正努力透過對話與溝通機制來穩定關係，避免衝突升級。選項 A 錯誤，文中提到雙方都在尋求管理技術發展的方法；選項 B 錯誤，週年慶僅是背景資訊；選項 D 錯誤，文章並未提到貿易戰已結束，僅提到雙方致力於保持溝通以防衝突。
